## 2. Overnight / today world read (verified outside the bus)
**WARSH GAVE THEM NOTHING — and the October cloud resolved DOWN.** The Bangkok fireside (10:30am ICT, Reuters/AP/USA Today): the Chair reaffirmed price stability, cited the September hike to 3.75-4.00% as 'removed a dose of accommodation,' flagged the AI investment surge as a near-term inflationary demand shock, and refused any path signal — 'I don't prejudge meetings… It's a new chapter at the Fed, and we're not in that business anymore.' Market read (Yahoo markets wrap, S): CME October-hike odds fell to 17% from 28% pre-fireside; December-hike odds 89% (unchanged). S&P futures ticked up on the remarks. The 33.8-44% dispersion cloud from Thursday is retired; the board now prices HOLD-hike, exactly the Williams/minutes sequencing. BLACKOUT is now in force (started Oct-17) — no Fed voice until the Oct 27-28 decision. September PCE prints Oct-29, the day AFTER the meeting.

**THE LONG END HELD WHILE EQUITIES BROKE.** ^TNX Friday: O 5.114 / H 5.133 / L 5.067 / C 5.098 (+0.9bp d/d; Yahoo via agent-gw ~23:05 UTC; TE prints 5.09-5.11, convergent). Thursday's fade did not extend; the 10Y sits 9.8bp over the 5.00 fail line. But the growth-damage tape accelerated below the surface: Nasdaq -2.1% Friday, -4.5% on the week (four-week streak snapped); S&P -1.2% Friday, -2.0% week (4th down week in 6); Dow -0.3% Friday but +0.7% on the week — second straight weekly gain. Energy led sectors (+2.51%), Tech worst (-2.63%); CoreWeave -12% (second big drop in three). Breadth 2,977 adv / 6,694 dec. This is the policy-error tape: hot inflation, falling stocks, bid under energy, rotation to value. Rates-stress leg state: fail condition is 10Y close <5.00 AND October odds <~50% — odds are now 17% (condition half-met since Thursday), 10Y 5.098 (not met). Leg survives, watch tightens.

**OIL — THE FIRED LEG RE-FIRED. Brent settled 109.69 (+3.56%), high 110.00.** Friday reversed the sanctions-easing fade violently: from ~$105.3 in the Asian/European morning (HDFC/5paisa) to a $110.00 tag intraday (TASS: first $109+ since Sep-15; TT News: first $110 since May — framing dispersion preserved), settling 109.69 (Yahoo BZ=F via agent-gw; straits.live confirms settle +3.56%). WTI CL=F settled 99.04 (+1.09%) after topping $100 intraday (CNBC); NY diesel settled $4.90/gal, highest-ever seasonal. Catalysts, stacked: (1) CNBC — Iran escalated Hormuz attacks, Ukraine vowed to hit Russian refineries (Ryazan strike reported by Reuters); (2) Trump told Newsmax he does NOT rule out GBU-43/B MOAB use on Iran after Nov-3 — CNN reported the strike planning earlier in the week; (3) Rep. Meeks introduced the bipartisan 'No Corrupt Russian Oil Deals Act' to kill the Trump-Putin diesel deal (revoke OFAC GLs, bar DFC investment) — the GL 135 policy leg just picked up a legislative counter-force; (4) EIA confirmed the -8.557M bbl draw (w/e Oct-9, to 415.577M vs -288K expected); (5) supply-side answers so far: IEA >20M bbl diesel release agreed Thursday; US offered up to 17M SPR barrels Friday. Eurasia Group raised escalation odds 35%->65%. Weekly: Brent +5%+, second straight weekly gain. Fired leg day 5: settle is now +4.97 over the 104.72 firing settle. **BZ=F volume dup MIGRATED again: Oct-14 revised 37,813->38,456 and Oct-15 carries the same 38,456 — twelfth artifact cycle.** Oct-15 Brent close revised up to 105.92 from the 105.70 forming mark.

**HORMUZ — fog thickens; another tanker burns.** gCaptain: UKMTO warns MOST ship attacks in the strait now go UNREPORTED — the documented ledger is a lower bound. Iran Army Navy identified a 'violating' oil tanker on fire in a restricted zone east of the strait (AIS switched off; name/flag/cause undisclosed) — Tehran is fusing AIS monitoring + self-declared zones into a de facto enforcement regime (Schaaf). Tehran Times (unverified, single-source): Iran reaffirms closure, passage must be coordinated. IMO seeking to resume navigation talks (unverified, Sawt al-Imarat). IMF PortWatch: 2 transits Oct-11 vs 85/day baseline (straits.live; stale stamp). straits.live: 218 AIS-visible vessels holding off-berth in the watch box at 21:22 UTC; Hormuz Index Crisis Pressure extreme band. CONTRADICTION (preserved below): TT News says waterway cargo volumes 'nearing prewar levels, topping 100M barrels last week' vs TE 'flows fell to 11.62M b/d (week to Oct-13) from a 17.15M baseline' vs PortWatch 2 transits — three irreconcilable lenses on the same physical pipe.

**SAUDI — decision point lands tonight.** Riyadh NOTAM closure runs to 2100 GMT Oct-17 (Reuters, S) — reopen-or-extend ~21h after filing. Air India/Gulf Air cancelled through Oct-17. TT News: Houthis 'continue to pummel Saudi Arabia with missile and drone strikes.' Schaaf: Houthis encircling Taiz (Bab el-Mandeb pressure); Hezbollah publicly confirmed seized explosives were intended for operations against Israel; EASA Saudi CZIB active to Nov-16.

**CRYPTO — revision drift hits SEVEN; SOL's hard falsifier probed a second time.** BTC: Oct-15 REVISED DOWN -63.11 to 82,141.46 (seventh consecutive downward revision; cumulative ~-524; 31st revision cycle); Oct-15 low also revised to 79,735.86 — ~$836 over the 78,900 falsifier. Oct-16 provisional C 81,641.04 (-0.61%; O 82,132.23 matches Yahoo's news print; H 82,717.27 / L 80,735.26) — provisional 29th session above 78,900 on closes. SOL: Oct-15 revised down -0.10 to 105.33; Oct-16 provisional C 104.30 (-0.98%; L 102.65 — SECOND intraday probe below the $103 hard falsifier; the contract is closes and the close holds). Third consecutive close below the 105.84 zone (104.07r / 105.33r / 104.30p). ETH: Oct-16 provisional 2,420.75 (-0.81%; L 2,391.26). ETF flows: Farside Oct-15 row FLAT $0.0M across funds (Satsintel) — the -261.4M bleed paused, not reversed; October MTD ~-$537M; Oct-16 row pending at filing. SOL-specific: spot SOL ETF outflows ended a 14-week inflow streak (coinstats, B); Alpenglow upgrade set for Oct-21 — first scheduled protocol catalyst on this board.

**Elsewhere.** Gold GC=F settled 4,186.70 Friday (+0.40% d/d). Copper ~$6.55-6.63, -0.9%. DXY not pulled this cycle.

**Data-path check:** **Binance 29th check — DEGRADED/PARTIAL**: round 1 (BTCUSDT) EMPTY_DATA; round 2 (SOLUSDT,ETHUSDT) EMPTY_DATA; round 3 BTCUSDT OK: 81,750.0 (-0.626% 24h; H 82,940.81 / L 80,809.25) — -0.6% 24h matches Yahoo provisional -0.61%, cross-venue consistent; SOL/ETH legs dark this cycle. - No new thesis on the bus to interrogate, thirty-fourth cycle. Nova CONCUR/VETO queue unchanged (argus_002, argus_003, T-2026-09-11-001 post-hoc, orbital_001) — thirty-seventh cycle on the oldest. Idle-task per PROMPT_FOR_ARGUS: orbital and nova have left nothing new unfalsified since Sep-11; the standing unfalsified set is the queue above.
- Self-interrogation, scored: (1) **WARSH'S SILENCE WAS THE SIGNAL** — the Chair had one pre-blackout chance to keep October live after a double-hot CPI/PPI week and chose 'we're not in that business anymore.' Odds collapsed 28->17%. Read: the Fed wants December, not October, and won't fight the market to say so. The hot-data leg of the CPI gate is now pure December pricing (89%). (2) **THE SANCTIONS-EASING FADE LASTED ~18 HOURS** — Thursday's >$1 Brent dip on shipping-sanctions-ease headlines was obliterated by Friday's +3.56% re-fire. The desk's GL 135 stance (licenses ≠ cargo flows) is now joined by a bipartisan bill to revoke the licenses outright. Policy relief is being bid away faster than it can be written. (3) **POLICY-ERROR TAPE CONFIRMED ACROSS ASSETS** — October odds down, 10Y steady at 5.10, Nasdaq -4.5% week, energy +2.5% sector lead, gold bid, Dow up on the week: the market is pricing inflation the Fed won't fight until December and growth that can't wait. That is the most coherent cross-asset read since this watch began. (4) **BOTH SOL FALSIFIERS NOW PROBED TWICE** — 101.03 (Thu) and 102.65 (Fri) intraday vs the $103 hard falsifier; closes hold (104.30 provisional). The zone-not-price stance is being tested exactly as pre-committed; no amendment without a revised close below 103. (5) **BTC SEVENTH DOWNWARD REVISION** — drift now ~-524 cumulative; each provisional close prints ~0.05-0.2% rich. Treat all provisional closes as +0.1% optimistic until the pattern breaks. (6) **UKMTO's 'most attacks unreported' admission re-rates the ledger itself** — the incident count is a floor, not a measure; escalation inference should weight transits/flows/insurance over counts. (7) **Dead escalation re-arm stays dead** — the MOAB non-denial, Meeks bill, mines, and the $110 tag do not resurrect it; re-entry requires a NEW signal with its own thesis, evidence, falsifier.
